description: Remove stored HTTP Basic Auth credentials. Omit "origin" to clear all stored credentials; pass "origin" to clear just that site.

origin.description: Optional origin to clear (e.g. "https://staging.example.com"). Omit to clear all stored credentials.

tab.description: The tab to drive: a handle of this session such as "t2" (list_tabs, new_tab). Default: the session's current tab.

name: clear_basic_auth
